seoTitle: Radar Chart Maker: Spider Chart Comparison (SVG)
metaDescription: Compare items across the same attributes as overlapping polygons on a radar chart with rings, legend and a data table. Free, local.
intro: Draws a radar (spider) chart. Each row is an item, each column an attribute, and each item becomes a polygon on shared axes.
why:
Radar charts compare a few items on several scores, such as products against criteria or skills across a team. All axes share one scale, set automatically or by you, so polygons are comparable.

Radar charts are easy to misread: area grows with the square of scores, and the order of axes changes the shape. Use them for 3 to 8 attributes and 2 to 4 items, and keep the table as the exact reference.
howTo: Paste a header row of attributes and one row of scores per item.
Set an axis maximum if scores share a known scale such as 10.
